new_jobs.jd: 負責規劃與執行全球 AI 策略客戶及合作夥伴之商務開發（Business Development）戰略，深化與 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 等國際 AI 生態系巨頭之關鍵夥伴關係。此職位將帶領團隊，與公司內部之產品、技術、行銷及高階管理層密切合作，發掘全球性新商機，建立晶片（SoC）級與基礎設施級的關鍵合作，並將 AI 頂尖解決方案成功導入全球企業客戶與市場。 主要工作職責 1\. 策略規劃與推動：制定並執行全球 AI 商務拓展戰略，主導國際級 AI 策略專案，建立長期且具市場影響力的關鍵夥伴關係。 2\. 高階客戶經營：深入洞察全球指標客戶之 AI 發展藍圖（Roadmap）與關鍵技術需求，主導高階商業模式談判，確保雙方核心專案成功落地。 3\. 跨部門與團隊領導：帶領SoC商務開發團隊，整合研發（RD）、產品管理（PM）、業務（Sales）、技術支援（FAE）及高階主管資源，加速專案推進。 4\. 商業決策與布局：依據全球市場脈動，主導 AI 產品、市場定位及商業合作策略之規劃，為公司發掘下一代藍海市場。 5\. 產業生態系洞察：持續追蹤並精準解讀全球 AI 產業、生成式 AI、AI Infra.、大型語言模型（LLM）與 GPU 生態系發展趨勢，並迅速轉化為公司具體的商業競爭優勢。 6\. 國際商務代表：代表公司與國際一線科技大廠之高階決策層（C\-Level）進行商務與技術策略交流，建立並鞏固公司在國際 AI 市場的領先地位。 應徵條件 1\. 學歷背景：碩士或大學以上學歷，資訊工程、電機電子、資訊管理、商管或相關科系。 2\. 資深業界經驗：具備8年以上 科技產業商務開發（BD）、方案銷售經驗。其中需包含2年以上 AI 應用/軟硬體/Infrastructure、或生成式 AI 相關領域之深耕經驗。 3\. 管理實績：具備3年以上 跨國商務開發團隊或專案團隊之管理經驗，具備良好的領導力、教練能力（Coaching）與人才培育實績。 4\. 核心能力：具備卓越的策略思維、高階商業談判技巧、危機處理以及強大的跨部門資源整合能力。 5\. 語言與跨國協調：具備極佳的英語聽、說、讀、寫能力，具備獨立與海外 C\-Level 客戶進行全英語商務及架構探討之能力。需有 TOEIC 880 (金色證書) 以上 或同等英語能力證明。人格特質：具備極高的自主性、抗壓性、宏觀視野，以及適應跨國時區與多元文化合作環境之彈性。 加分條件 1\. 熟悉 GPU、AI Server、Hyperscaler (Cloud)、LLM、Generative AI 或 AI Platform 生態系運作模式。 2\. 過去擁有與 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel、Qualcomm 等國際半導體（VPs / Directors）直接對接、談判、共同行銷或共同開發之成功合作案例。 3\. 具備大型財星 500 大企業客戶或全球策略客戶（Strategic Account）之實際管理與破億規模專案結案經驗。 4\. 深入理解企業端 AI 導入、AI 解決方案或 AI 系統架構規劃（AI System Architecture）。 Job Description Responsible for planning and executing business development strategies for global AI strategic accounts and partners, and deepening key partnerships with international AI ecosystem giants such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel. This role will lead a team and collaborate closely with internal product, technical, marketing, and executive management teams to identify new global business opportunities, establish critical collaborations at the chip (SoC) and infrastructure levels, and successfully introduce top\-tier AI solutions to global enterprise clients and markets. Key Responsibilities 1\. Strategic Planning \& Execution: Formulate and execute global AI business development strategies, lead international strategic AI projects, and establish long\-term, high\-impact key partnerships. 2\. Key Account Management: Gain deep insights into the AI roadmaps and critical technical requirements of global benchmark clients, lead high\-level business model negotiations, and ensure the successful implementation of core mutual projects. 3\. Cross\-functional \& Team Leadership: Lead the SoC business development team, and integrate resources across R\&D, Product Management (PM), Sales, Field Application Engineering (FAE), and executive leadership to accelerate project progression. 4\. Business Decision\-Making \& Strategy: Plan AI product positioning, market targeting, and business cooperation strategies based on global market dynamics to discover next\-generation blue ocean markets for the company. 5\. Industry Ecosystem Insights: Continuously track and precisely interpret trends in the global AI industry, Generative AI, AI Infrastructure, Large Language Models (LLMs), and GPU ecosystems, rapidly translating them into concrete competitive advantages for the company. 6\. International Business Representation: Represent the company in business and technical strategic communication with C\-level executives of top\-tier international tech companies, establishing and consolidating the company’s leading position in the global AI market. Qualifications \& RequirementsEducation 1\. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). 2\. Industry Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in technology industry business development (BD) or solution sales, including at least 2 years of focused experience in AI applications, hardware/software, infrastructure, or Generative AI domains. 3\. Management Track Record: Minimum of 3 years of experience managing multinational business development or project teams, demonstrating strong leadership, coaching abilities, and a proven track record in talent development. 4\. Core Competencies: Exceptional strategic thinking, high\-level business negotiation skills, crisis management capabilities, and robust cross\-functional resource integration abilities. 5\. Language \& Global Coordination: Excellent English proficiency in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, with the ability to independently conduct full\-English business and architecture discussions with overseas C\-level clients. A minimum score of TOEIC 880 (Golden Certificate) or equivalent English proficiency certification is required.Personal Traits: High autonomy, strong resilience under pressure, a global macro\-perspective, and the flexibility to adapt to cross\-timezone and multicultural collaborative environments. Preferred Qualifications 1\. Ecosystem Familiarity: Proven familiarity with the operational models of GPU, AI Server, Hyperscaler (Cloud), LLM, Generative AI, or AI Platform ecosystems. 2\. Key Ecosystem Engagement: Demonstrated success in direct engagement, negotiation, co\-marketing, or co\-development with global semiconductor leaders such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, or Qualcomm at the VP or Director level. 3\. Enterprise Track Record: Hands\-on management experience with Fortune 500 or global strategic accounts, including a proven track record of closing high\-value projects valued at over 100 million NTD (or equivalent scale). 4\. Technical Depth: In\-depth understanding of enterprise AI adoption, enterprise AI solutions, or AI System Architecture planning.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Compute Systems
new_jobs.jd: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states. Waymo's Compute Team is tasked with a critical and exciting mission: We deliver the compute platform responsible for running the fully autonomous vehicle’s software stack. To achieve our mission, we architect and create high\-performance custom silicon; we develop system\-level compute architectures that push the boundaries of performance, power, and latency; and we collaborate closely with many other teammates to ensure we design and optimize hardware and software for maximum performance. We are a multidisciplinary team seeking curious and talented teammates to work on one of the world’s highest performance automotive compute platforms. *This role follows a hybrid work schedule, and you will report to the Tech Lead Manager of the Compute team.* **You Will** * Design and implement full stack solution from firmware, low\-level drivers, APIs for ML accelerator chips * Analyze and optimize firmware and driver performance for demanding AI workloads * Collaborate with hardware engineers closely throughout the ASIC design and verification processes * Design and implement efficient memory management solutions including NUMA, IOMMU, etc **You Have** * 3\+ years of experience in software development * Baremetal or RTOS firmware development experience * Experience with embedded architectures, IO technologies (e.g. PCIe, DRAM, AXI, etc.), and hardware/software interactions * Strong C, C\+\+ skills **We Prefer** * Experience with RISC\-V architecture * Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow or JAX * Familiar with hardware\-software co\-design principles * Experience with silicon emulator The expected base salary range for this full\-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. Salary Range $2,600,000—$3,150,000 TWD

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Solutions Architecture
new_jobs.jd: **Description** Do you like helping customers solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies including GenAI and agentic AI? Do you have a knack for helping companies understand infrastructure and application architectures including migration, modernization, and integration approaches? Do you thrive for the chance to be consultative while leading the launch of transformational projects on a trajectory to success? AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector. This is an on\-site position requiring regular presence at AWS offices and customer locations to deliver hands\-on technical engagement and build strong customer relationships. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world\-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission\-critical applications on top of AWS services. As a Solution Architect within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon's utility computing web services including compute, storage, networking, database, analytics, application services, deployment, management, developer, mobile, Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, agentic AI solutions, security, hybrid and enterprise applications within Enterprise Accounts including retail, transportation, e\-commerce industries and more. You will own the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, with a strong focus on: GenAI and Agentic AI adoption: Driving customer outcomes with generative AI solutions and intelligent automation Migration and Modernization: Leading datacenter exit strategies, VMware migrations, and cloud\-native transformation initiatives Security and Resilience: Strengthening customer security posture and building resilient architectures Customer Expansion: Accelerating adoption through technical excellence and outcome\-driven engagement The ideal candidate will develop deep expertise in AWS technologies as well as broad know\-how around how modern applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform, including containerization, serverless architectures, and AI/ML services. You will possess customer\-facing skills that allow you to represent AWS well within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables you to easily interact and give guidance to software developers, architects, and C\-level executives on digital transformation strategies. Key job responsibilities * Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team in enabling customers to build best practice, capabilities, and solutions on the AWS platform * Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria * Own each technical enablement and engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value * Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community A day in the life As a Solution Architect at AWS, you'll drive customer success through technical excellence and strategic guidance. You'll engage with C\-level executives and engineering teams on GenAI adoption strategies, lead modernization initiatives, and design cloud\-native architectures. Your work includes conducting Well\-Architected Reviews, facilitating Immersion Days and workshops, and collaborating with Account Managers and Specialist SAs on customer expansion strategies. You'll balance hands\-on technical deep dives with executive\-level discussions, directly impacting customer outcomes in datacenter exits, AI/ML workloads, and security resilience—making this role ideal for those who thrive at the intersection of technology and business transformation. **About The Team** AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you don't meet all qualifications, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you. AWS is the world's most comprehensive cloud platform. Our employee\-led affinity groups and events like CORE and AmazeCon foster inclusion. We offer endless mentorship and career\-advancing resources as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. We value work\-life harmony—when supported at work and home, there's nothing we can't achieve. **Basic Qualifications** * 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience * 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience * 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries * Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud * Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. **Company** \- Amazon Web Services Taiwan Limited Job ID: A10458616

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ring AI (Edge AI), RBKS AI
new_jobs.jd: **Description** With affordable solutions that work on any home, Ring is committed to offering smart security that's accessible to everyone. Now Ring AI is seeking experienced software engineers to build the on\-device intelligence that powers the next generation of Ring cameras and doorbells. What will you help us create? You'll develop Edge AI software for embedded systems that protect millions of homes worldwide. Your work will bring computer vision and machine learning models onto resource\-constrained devices — turning raw video into meaningful signals for our customers, in real time, on\-device. Beyond leveraging AI agents and Generative AI tools, you'll also contribute to AI\-powered workflows that are reshaping how embedded software gets built. Backed by Amazon's world\-class AI resources and infrastructure, you'll have the support to continuously explore emerging AI technologies, enhance your skills, and drive innovation in product development. Key job responsibilities As a Software Development Engineer on Ring AI (Edge AI), you'll be a core member of the team building the on\-device perception stack. You'll collaborate with engineers and applied scientists across multiple countries, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and global\-scale product development. This is a unique opportunity to grow your career within a multi\-national technology leader while working alongside some of the brightest minds in embedded computer vision. The ideal candidate would be passionate about building intelligent IoT products and eager to push the boundaries of what neural networks can do on constrained embedded targets.
